name: VisIt Data Parallel Volume Rendering
aliases: VisIt Data Parallel Volume Rendering for AMR
definition: A data parallel volume rendering scheme in VisIt that resolves complex sorting issues in unstructured meshes and handles AMR load balancing by minimizing coarse patches per processor and ignoring ghost cell samples.
summary: VisIt Data Parallel Volume Rendering is a parallel scheme for AMR meshes that treats patches as atomic units and ignores ghost cells to ensure correct sampling and load balancing.
